Summary

COBIL00C is a CICS online bill payment program within the CardDemo application that allows users to pay their credit card account balance in full. The program reads the account details, retrieves the associated card cross-reference, generates a new transaction record for the bill payment, updates the account balance to zero, and presents the user with a confirmation screen showing the transaction ID upon successful payment.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: VSAM/CICS Files (ACCTDAT, CXACAIX, TRANSACT) - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Session Initialization - When the program is first invoked (no communication area), redirect the user to the sign-on screen, ensuring only authenticated users can access the bill payment function. 2: Screen Entry Setup - On first entry into the bill payment screen, initialize the display fields, pre-populate the Account ID if one was passed from a previous screen, and display the bill payment screen to the user. 3: User Input Reception - Receive and capture the data entered by the user on the bill payment screen, including Account ID and payment confirmation indicator. 4: Navigation Key Handling - Process function key presses: PF3 returns the user to the previous screen (or main menu if no prior screen), PF4 clears the current screen, and any other invalid key displays an error message. 5: Account ID Validation - Validate that the Account ID field is not blank or empty before proceeding; display an error message prompting the user to enter an Account ID if it is missing. 6: Payment Confirmation Input Handling - Evaluate the confirmation field entered by the user: accept 'Y' or 'y' to proceed with payment, accept 'N' or 'n' to cancel and clear the screen, treat blank as a request to look up the account without confirming, and reject any other value with an error message. 7: Account Balance Lookup - Retrieve the current account balance and account details from the account data file using the provided Account ID, displaying an error if the account is not found. 8: Zero Balance Check - After retrieving the account, verify that the current balance is greater than zero; if the balance is zero or negative, inform the user there is nothing to pay and prevent further processing. 9: Display Current Balance - Display the current account balance on the bill payment screen so the user can review the amount due before confirming payment. 10: Prompt for Payment Confirmation - When the account is found and has a balance but the user has not yet confirmed, prompt the user to confirm the bill payment by displaying a confirmation message. 11: Card Cross-Reference Lookup - When the user confirms payment, retrieve the card number associated with the account from the card cross-reference file using the Account ID. 12: New Transaction ID Generation - Determine the next available transaction ID by browsing the transaction file from the highest existing transaction ID backwards to find the last used ID, then increment it by one to generate a unique new transaction ID. 13: Bill Payment Transaction Record Creation - Build a new transaction record with all required details: the new transaction ID, transaction type code '02', category code 2, source 'POS TERM', description 'BILL PAYMENT - ONLINE', the full current account balance as the payment amount, the associated card number, merchant ID 999999999, merchant name 'BILL PAYMENT', and current timestamp for both origination and processing times. 14: Transaction Record Write - Write the newly created bill payment transaction record to the transaction file, ensuring no duplicate transaction IDs exist. 15: Account Balance Update - After successfully recording the transaction, subtract the payment amount from the account's current balance (resulting in zero balance) and update the account record in the account data file. 16: Payment Success Notification - Upon successful completion of the bill payment, display a success message to the user in green text showing the transaction ID assigned to the payment, and clear all input fields for a fresh entry. 17: Screen Clear / Reset - Clear all input and display fields on the bill payment screen (Account ID, current balance, confirmation field, and messages) and redisplay a blank bill payment screen. 18: Bill Payment Screen Display - Populate the screen header with application title, program name, transaction ID, current date, and current time, then render the bill payment screen with any relevant messages or data. 19: Return to Previous Screen - Transfer control back to the calling program or the main menu, passing along the communication area with updated program context information.

Datasource Information (3)

Datasource Name Type Usage
ACCTDAT CICS File (VSAM) Read and update account record to retrieve current balance and reduce it after bill payment
CXACAIX CICS File (VSAM - Alternate Index) Read card cross-reference record by account ID to retrieve the associated card number for the transaction
TRANSACT CICS File (VSAM) Browse to determine the last transaction ID, then write a new bill payment transaction record

1. **Initializing and Sending the Screen (SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN)** ```cobol SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN. PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COBIL0A') MAPSET('COBIL00') FROM(COBIL0AO) ERASE CURSOR END-EXEC. ``` - Populates header fields and sends the Bill Payment screen (COBIL0A) to the terminal. --- 2. **Receiving Input from the Screen (RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN)** ```cobol RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN. EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COBIL0A') MAPSET('COBIL00') INTO(COBIL0AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC. ``` - Receives user input from the Bill Payment screen into the input map structure (COBIL0AI). --- 3. **Populating Header Fields (POPULATE-HEADER-INFO)** ```cobol POPULATE-HEADER-INFO. MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF COBIL0AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF COBIL0AO MOVE WS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF COBIL0AO MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO PGMNAMEO OF COBIL0AO MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF COBIL0AO MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF COBIL0AO. ``` - Populates TRNNAMEO (Transaction Name), TITLE01O (Title Line 1), TITLE02O (Title Line 2), PGMNAMEO (Program Name), CURDATEO (Current Date), and CURTIMEO (Current Time) output fields. --- 4. **Validating Account ID Input Field** ```cobol WHEN ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Acct ID can NOT be empty...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL OF COBIL0AI PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN ``` - Checks if the Account ID input field (ACTIDINI) is empty and sets cursor to the Account ID field (ACTIDINL = -1) with an error message. --- 5. **Processing Account ID and Confirmation Field** ```cobol MOVE ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI TO ACCT-ID XREF-ACCT-ID EVALUATE CONFIRMI OF COBIL0AI WHEN 'Y' WHEN 'y' SET CONF-PAY-YES TO TRUE PERFORM READ-ACCTDAT-FILE WHEN 'N' WHEN 'n' PERFORM CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG WHEN SPACES WHEN LOW-VALUES PERFORM READ-ACCTDAT-FILE WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Invalid value. Valid values are (Y/N)...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO CONFIRML OF COBIL0AI PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN END-EVALUATE ``` - Reads the Account ID input (ACTIDINI) and the Confirmation field (CONFIRMI) to determine the next action. Sets cursor to CONFIRML if invalid value entered. --- 6. **Displaying Current Balance** ```cobol MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO WS-CURR-BAL MOVE WS-CURR-BAL TO CURBALI OF COBIL0AI ``` - Moves the retrieved account balance to the Current Balance display field (CURBALI) on the screen. --- 7. **Checking Zero Balance** ```cobol IF ACCT-CURR-BAL <= ZEROS AND ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'You have nothing to pay...' TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL OF COBIL0AI PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN END-IF ``` - Validates that the account has a positive balance before allowing payment. Displays error if balance is zero or negative. --- 8. **Displaying Success Message after Payment** ```cobol WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL) PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF COBIL0AO STRING 'Payment successful. ' DELIMITED BY SIZE ' Your Transaction ID is ' DELIMITED BY SIZE TRAN-ID DELIMITED BY SPACE '.' DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN ``` - After successful payment, sets the error message field (ERRMSGO) color to green and displays a success message with the new Transaction ID. --- 9. **Clearing the Screen (CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN / INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS)** ```cobol CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN. PERFORM INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN. INITIALIZE-ALL-FIELDS. MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL OF COBIL0AI MOVE SPACES TO ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI CURBALI OF COBIL0AI CONFIRMI OF COBIL0AI WS-MESSAGE. ``` - Clears the Account ID (ACTIDINI), Current Balance (CURBALI), and Confirmation (CONFIRMI) input/output fields and resets the cursor to the Account ID field. --- 10. **Initial Screen Entry (First Time Display)** ```cobol IF NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COBIL0AO MOVE -1 TO ACTIDINL OF COBIL0AI IF CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES MOVE CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED TO ACTIDINI OF COBIL0AI PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY END-IF PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN ``` - On first entry, initializes the output map (COBIL0AO) to LOW-VALUES, sets cursor to Account ID field, and optionally pre-populates the Account ID if passed from a previous screen. --- 11. **Handling Function Key Navigation** ```cobol EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHENTER PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY WHEN DFHPF3 IF CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES MOVE 'COMEN01C' TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM ELSE MOVE CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM END-IF PERFORM RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN WHEN DFHPF4 PERFORM CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN WHEN OTHER MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN END-EVALUATE ``` - Handles ENTER key (process payment), PF3 (navigate back), PF4 (clear screen), and any other invalid key (display error in ERRMSGO).
